components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action per view (Play). Solid Reading Lamp, semibold white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b45309; color: #fff; font: 600 12.5px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.12s ease, transform 0.06s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(0.94); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-primary { background: #fbbf24; color: #1c1917; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline-color: #fbbf24; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — Open in page, Preview, clear. Recedes until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; font: 11.5px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, transform 0.06s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #1c1917; border-color: #57534e; } .ds-btn-ghost:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-ghost { background: #292524; color: #a8a29e; border-color: #44403c; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #f5f5f4; border-color: #a8a29e; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline-color: #fbbf24; } }

components.name: Transport Row
components.description: ⏮ ▶ ⏭ ⏹ around a flex-growing primary Play; icon buttons take the lamp-glow wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-transport { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-tbtn { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font: 12.5px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, transform 0.06s ease; } .ds-tbtn:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #1c1917; border-color: #57534e; background: rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.12); } .ds-tbtn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-tbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tbtn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-tplay { flex: 1; background: #b45309; color: #fff; font: 600 12.5px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.12s ease, transform 0.06s ease; } .ds-tplay:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-tplay:active { filter: brightness(0.94); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-tplay:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tbtn { background: #292524; color: #f5f5f4; border-color: #44403c; } .ds-tbtn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.14); border-color: #a8a29e; } .ds-tplay { background: #fbbf24; color: #1c1917; } }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: Voice and speed pickers — sheet on paper, amber focus ring.
components.css: .ds-select { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; font: 12.5px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-select:focus { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-select { background: #292524; color: #f5f5f4; border-color: #44403c; } .ds-select:focus { outline-color: #fbbf24; } }

components.name: Capability Chip
components.description: Engine capability disclosure — free · on-device · word timing. Pure pill, no interaction.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #ffffff; color: #57534e; font: 10.5px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 7px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-chip { background: #292524; color: #a8a29e; border-color: #44403c; } }

components.name: Floating Bar
components.description: The signature surface: scheme-locked dark stone pill with glass-tint controls and the system's only shadow. Draggable.

components.css: .ds-bar { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; background: #292524; color: #f9fafb; font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / .35); cursor: grab; user-select: none; } .ds-barbtn { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .1); color: inherit; font: inherit; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .25); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease, filter 0.12s ease, transform 0.06s ease; } .ds-barbtn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .22); } .ds-barbtn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.96); filter: brightness(0.85); } .ds-barbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-barbtn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; } .ds-barstatus { color: #a8a29e; font-size: 11px; max-width: 180px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Theme Swatch
components.description: Highlight-theme picker tile, split diagonally to preview both bands; radio semantics, amber selected ring.
components.css: .ds-swatch { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; cursor: pointer; font: 10px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-swatch-chip { width: 34px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.42) 50%, rgba(146, 94, 6, 0.55) 50%); } .ds-swatch-label { color: #57534e; } .ds-swatch[aria-checked="true"] { border-color: #b45309; background: rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.12); } .ds-swatch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-swatch-label { color: #1c1917; font-weight: 600; } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b45309; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-swatch-chip { border-color: #44403c; } .ds-swatch-label { color: #a8a29e; } .ds-swatch[aria-checked="true"] { border-color: #fbbf24; background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.14); } .ds-swatch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-swatch-label { color: #f5f5f4; } }

narrative.overview: Leia is a reading companion, not an app that happens to read. The visual world is a quiet library: warm stone surfaces the color of paper and linen bindings, a single amber lamp for attention, and type set in the browser's own native voice. Every surface exists to get out of the way of the page being read — the loudest thing in the product is the moving highlight on someone else's website, never the chrome around it. Two extension surfaces share this world: the popup (a narrow, flat, hairline-sectioned panel in warm paper light or evening-stone dark) and the floating bar (a dark stone pill that drifts over arbitrary pages and can be dragged anywhere). The third surface is not chrome at all: the marching highlight, painted directly onto the host page's text through the CSS Custom Highlight API, contrast-checked against whatever background it lands on. Controls are quiet and state-honest: every control visibly answers hover, press, focus, disabled, and loading, but nothing performs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone neutrals only — cool slates and blues are off-palette drift.
One amber accent per scheme; its rarity is the point.
Flat popup, one shadow in the whole system (the floating bar).
Native system-ui type; counters in tabular numerals.
Dark scheme by prefers-color-scheme only — no manual toggle.
The brand mark (amber-haired Leia with reading glasses on a stone-900 disc) carries the same two hues as the UI.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent on chrome surfaces. If a second saturated hue appears on a button, badge, or border, it is drift — the semantic greens/reds are for state text only.

rules.name: The Honest Contrast Rule
rules.body: A highlight variant ships only if its ink clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 against its own wash composited over the sampled page background — computed, not eyeballed. When no variant clears AA, the system falls back to an underline-only variant that touches no colors.

rules.name: The Native Stack Rule
rules.body: No webfonts, ever. A content script cannot afford font loading, and a toolbar popup shouldn't want it. If a surface needs character, reach for color, spacing, or the icon — not a typeface.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Popup surfaces never cast shadows. If a panel needs separation, add a deckle-line border or a tonal step, not a shadow. Shadows belong to things that float over content the user owns.

dos: Do keep every neutral on the warm stone ramp (warm-paper → umber-ink); Marginalia text must hold ≥4.5:1 on its ground in both schemes.
Do use the 2px amber focus ring (1px offset) on every focusable element, both surfaces.
Do handle dark scheme exclusively through prefers-color-scheme token swaps.
Do keep counters and positions in tabular-nums.
Do answer every interaction state — hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, loading — with the quiet grammar above.
Do paint the reading highlight with the Custom Highlight API (::highlight), which never mutates the host page's DOM.
donts: Don't introduce cool slates, blues, or pure grays on chrome surfaces — that drift was corrected once (the bar's old slate pill) and stays corrected.
Don't add webfonts or a second typeface.
Don't cast shadows inside the popup; one shadow system-wide, and it belongs to the bar.
Don't add saturated accent colors beyond the one amber; state hues are text-only.
Don't ship a highlight theme variant without the computed AA check; the underline-only fallback is the honest answer on hard backgrounds.
Don't use !important in popup CSS, and in the bar's injected stylesheet only against inline cssText.
Don't use image or GIF spinners; motion is CSS-only.
